headline: Tokyo's police force plans to set up a dedicated unit in April 2027 to handle permits and accident investigations for self-driving cars.
score_reason: Kept at 5: a concrete official plan reported by a major outlet, but only the opening paragraph of the paywalled article was readable, so detail and doubts are unknown.
importance_line: Tokyo residents and robotaxi operators such as Waymo are due to get a dedicated police office for permits and crash investigations from 2027, but the unit's size and powers are not yet known.
summary: Nikkei Asia reports that the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department plans to establish a dedicated unit in April 2027 to prepare for the spread of autonomous vehicles, strengthening procedures for granting permits and developing methods to investigate accidents involving self-driving cars. Nikkei adds that Waymo plans to begin commercial driverless robotaxi service in Tokyo in 2027.
notes: Paywalled: only the opening paragraph and a photo caption were read. The summary uses only those.
